text:
Maria (CSM): Heads-up: AegisInsure submitted a SIG + bespoke security questionnaire. They want CAIQ + KMS/HSM attestation and an audit-log export. Due EOD Friday. Also reported two problems: intermittent 401s on sig export yesterday, and a billing spike during exports. Can we triage?

Sophia (Solutions): Can you upload the form link? usually the bespoke asks are: key origin, rotation cadence, HSM cert, and sample logs.

Maria (CSM): Uploaded PDF here: https://redwood-files/links/aegis-qa-2024.pdf. Key asks: HSM attestation signed, export sample (redacted), mapping of retention policies to our retention tiers, and confirmation we never persist plaintext customer keys.

Dan (Security): @Sophia I'll need the audit-log sample and any HSM certs we have. We have a standard attestation template but bespoke may want signer + timestamp. Also: 401s likely token expiry or refresh bug — please collect request IDs.

Kevin (Oncall): I captured the 401 spike around 2024-11-02 14:02 UTC. Repro I ran:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sig/export?job=123'
# sometimes responded 200, sometimes 401
```
Raw snippet from logs:
```
2024-11-02T14:02:04Z ERROR auth: token validate failed: jwt expired user_id=redacted request_id=req-9f8a
2024-11-02T14:02:04Z WARN router: upstream retry triggered request_id=req-9f8a
```

Oliver (Eng): We rolled a token-TTL change on 2024-11-02 13:57 UTC to tighten refresh behavior on bursty endpoints. That might explain 401s for longer-running export jobs. We can revert or add explicit refresh guidance in the export docs.

Sophia (Solutions): For the CAIQ we can provide our standard completed matrix + HSM attestation PDF. For the export sample we can produce a 3-line redacted CSV (no PII). Legal ok with redaction? @Maria

Maria (CSM): Customer confirmed redacted sample is acceptable. On billing: customer reports token/compute billing jumping from ~300 tokens/hr to ~1200 tokens/hr during export. Lina, can finance check invoice lines for that window?

Lina (Finance): I'll pull the invoice and usage lines for 2024-11-02 13:30–15:00 UTC. Kevin, do you have request IDs for the spike so I can correlate?

Kevin (Oncall): Req IDs: req-9f8a, req-9f8b, req-9f8c — looks like upstream retries caused 3x token counts for some jobs.

Dan (Security): Action items: (1) Sophia assemble CAIQ + attach attestation (2) Kevin/Oliver produce repro write-up + revert token-TTL or add refresh; roll a fix if needed (3) Lina to reconcile billing spike with request IDs (4) Maria to ask customer for due-date extension if needed. Target: draft package by Thu EOD.

Maria (CSM): :thumbsup: I'll ask AegisInsure for an extension to Monday if the draft isn't ready. Customer replied: "thanks — redacted logs are fine, extension to Mon is OK."

DeployBot: Deploy start: revert-token-ttl v1.2 — initiated 2024-11-03T03:12Z

Oliver (Eng): Revert completed, monitoring now. 401 rate dropped back to baseline in the last 15m.

Maria (CSM): I'll upload CAIQ + redacted sample tomorrow morning and update the ticket. Thanks everyone.
